h: Veekee James sparks pregnancy buzz months after welcoming daughter
p: Fashion designer Veekee James has set off pregnancy speculation with an Instagram photo many fans believe shows a baby bump, captioned 'The beginning of a beautiful bond', six months after welcoming her first child.
body: Celebrity fashion designer Veekee James has sparked talk of a second pregnancy after sharing a new photo on Instagram.

The photo, shared on Thursday, 12 November 2026, with the caption 'The beginning of a beautiful bond', appears to many fans to show a baby bump. Veekee did not directly confirm a pregnancy. Social media personality Enioluwa, comedian Broda Shaggi and reality star Tacha were among the celebrities who left congratulatory messages, while some fans were left confused.

Veekee James, whose full name is Victoria Atere James, and her husband Femi Atere welcomed their first daughter, Eliana, on 2 May 2026 in the United States. Earlier this week, she went viral after recounting an unusual test she set her husband to prove his love.
more: Veekee's new photo appears to show a baby bump.
She welcomed her first daughter in May.
She has not confirmed a pregnancy.
